About Senscat

Senscat is a digital service company that plans, develops, and operates services in education, enterprise AI analytics, and consultation operations.

센스매스(Sensmath) supports middle school math learning. 센스AI(SensAI) helps organizations understand AI usage, productivity, and subscription costs. 센스타로(Senstaro) helps tarot consultants create, edit, and share readings.

We keep each service practical, stable, and respectful of personal data.

Operating Principles

  • Experimentation

    We quickly test new ideas and are not afraid of failure.

  • Transparency

    We transparently disclose how services operate and communicate honestly with users.

  • User Respect

    We respect user choice and privacy, always prioritizing user experience.

Service Purposes

SM 센스매스

Sensmath is an AI-based diagnostic and supplementary learning service for middle school math.

AI 센스AI

SensAI is an enterprise AI and LLM usage observability, productivity analytics, and subscription optimization platform.

ST 센스타로

Tarot consultation support service for creating, editing, and sharing AI-assisted readings

센스냥(senscat)

A digital product studio that turns AI service ideas into products and improves them with operating data.
